title: Direct Salts Spearmint 10ml E-Liquid
description: Direct Salts Spearmint 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid provides a delicately sweet and beautifully smooth cooling experience. This authentic profile captures the true, slightly floral nature of fresh Spearmint, offering a crisp inhale with distinct sugary undertones. It serves as an exceptional palate cleanser, offering a milder, more delicate chill compared to classic menthol. This blend provides a gentle, continuous cooling effect paired with a pleasant, floral sweetness. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Direct Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Direct Salts collection offers vapers a dependable range of premium fruit, ice, and confectionery profiles. Providing a highly cost-effective and flexible option, this 10ml range covers a wide variety of tastes. Beyond the natural refreshment of Spearmint, vapers can explore other compelling options such as the sharp Lemon Lime, the robust Cherry Ice, or the complex Strawberry Raspberry Cherry.
